object.definition: An action is any subset of the ground set $[d]$. Random loss functions $f_t:2^{[d]}\to[0,1]$ are drawn i.i.d. from an unknown distribution $\mathcal D$, and each sample function is submodular. The mean function has a unique minimizing subset: $$\bar f(X)=\mathbb E_{f\sim\mathcal D}f(X),\qquad X^\star=\operatorname*{arg\,min}_{X\subseteq[d]}\bar f(X),$$ $$\Delta=\min_{X\ne X^\star}\bigl(\bar f(X)-\bar f(X^\star)\bigr)>0.$$

operation.query_signature: Draw the current function independently. The learner chooses $X_t$, incurs $f_t(X_t)$, then receives feedback. Only the value $f_t(X_t)$ at the selected subset is revealed; other subsets cannot be queried. Randomness comes from function sampling, without additional value noise. Causal policies are allowed. Inputs $d,T$ are public; distribution $\mathcal D$, gap $\Delta$, and optimal subset $X^\star$ are hidden. Received feedback may be stored and reused computationally. No unrevealed historical information or extra queries to exhausted samples are available; any within-round full-function or common-sample access must be explicit.

protocols.loss_bearing_points: In each round output a subset $X_t\subseteq[d]$. Final postprocessing cannot change losses already incurred. No separate optimal-subset recommendation or certificate is required.
protocols.past_requery: History may be stored. New information from old samples or past rounds is unavailable unless the native interface explicitly permits it.
steps: The current function is sampled independently. The algorithm chooses $X_t$ and incurs $f_t(X_t)$ before receiving the round's feedback.
Only one scalar $f_t(X_t)$ for the selected subset is returned; other subsets cannot be queried additionally.
Randomness comes from function sampling; no additional value-query noise is added.
Causal policies are allowed; $d$ and $T$ are public.
The distribution $\mathcal D$, gap $\Delta$, and optimal subset $X^\star$ are hidden.

Received feedback may be stored and reused in computation. Unrevealed information cannot be requested from past rounds, and consumed random samples cannot receive additional queries. Current-round exceptions are limited to the explicitly supplied full-function access or same-sample two-point interface.
